name: Pathological Fracture due to Bone Tumor
tags: pathological fracture due to bone tumor
definition: Fracture occurring through bone weakened by primary tumor, metastasis or other neoplastic lesion rather than normal traumatic loading.

investigations.principle: Radiographs of the entire bone plus oncologic staging are required before definitive fixation when malignancy is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Biopsy and fixation sequence must be planned oncologically.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna care is secondary to oncologic diagnosis and stabilization strategy.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture occurring through bone weakened by primary tumor, metastasis or other neoplastic lesion rather than normal traumatic loading.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
